title: sanguisorba lasiocarpa
intro: Sanguisorba lasiocarpa, commonly known as the mountain burnet, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). The health benefits of Sanguisorba lasiocarpa include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support wound healing. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Sanguisorba lasiocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
